messages:
Ivy (Product): Heads-up: customer pilot requires a tight BYOK onboarding checklist covering SOC2 evidence and retention. Need to scope MVP.
Marcus (Eng): Suggest minimal scope: export endpoint, immutable evidence blob, and documented retention tiers. UI later.
Jin (Security): Evidence must include handshake event stream, key metadata with rotation history, export SHA256, and an access log for the export action. Tamper-evident storage preferred.
Hannah (Solutions): Customers want an offline export option and a verification script. Also a rollback/restore playbook.
Omar (Legal): We'll need three default retention tiers and legal-hold language. Also clarify cross-region export constraints.
Marcus (Eng): Technical plan: add a small writer that appends signed records to object storage; produce an export bundle with manifest.json + sha256sum. Feature flag for rollout.
Jin (Security): Add a monotonic hash chain in manifest to make tampering detectable. Also require replay tests so evidence can reconstruct the handshake state.
Hannah (Solutions): Example CLI: `redwood keystore export --id $ID --offline` and `verify_export.sh export.tar.gz`.
Ivy (Product): Proposed MVP checklist: 1) `export?offline=true` endpoint + SHA256, 2) append-only evidence store (hash-chain), 3) export access audit, 4) documented retention defaults (90/365/999), 5) verification script + playbook.
Marcus (Eng): Timeline: can deliver items 1-3 behind `byok_evidence_mvp` in ~10 business days. Docs/legal need parallel work.
Omar (Legal): I'll draft contract language and legal-hold appendix. Will flag residency concerns.
Jin (Security): Also require that rotation metadata include signer IDs and timestamps.
Ivy (Product): Action items: Marcus -> PR for writer + export endpoint (due Fri), Jin -> evidence definition & test vectors, Omar -> retention/legal text, Hannah -> scripts + playbook. I'll assemble one-pager for signoff.
OpsBot: deploy-staging: feature-flag `byok_evidence_mvp` scheduled at 01:30 UTC.
Ivy (Product): Thanks team, aiming for pilot next sprint. Reopen if blockers.
